**The task.**

Add `truncate(text, max)` in a new file, src/truncate.mjs: it returns `text` unchanged when it has at most `max` characters, and otherwise cuts it and ends it with "…" (one character, U+2026) so that the result is exactly `max` characters long. A `text` that is not a string throws a TypeError, and a `max` that is not a positive integer throws a RangeError. Tests go in tests/truncate.test.mjs. A held-out set of cases exists outside this project and settles what this text leaves open; a critic judges against it, and it is NOT yours to read or run — build from the task, docs/REVIEW-CHECKLIST.md, and the README only. Do not open anything under the `.harness` directory.

- the task (above)
- docs/REVIEW-CHECKLIST.md (read it; it is the bar the critic judges against — note especially items 2, 3, 4, 5, 6)
- README.md, CHANGELOG.md, existing files in src/ and tests/ (to match style)

**Outputs you must leave behind before you report:**
1. The change, with tests: src/truncate.mjs and tests/truncate.test.mjs (use `node:test` and `node:assert`, matching the existing test style; no skipped or todo tests). Also a line under `## Unreleased` in CHANGELOG.md naming `truncate` and saying what it does, in the style of the entries below it.
2. CHANGES.md at the project root: what changed this round and which findings it addresses (this is round 0, so there are no prior findings — say so).
